history.summary: A freehold 2,013 sqft 3BR in East Coast 250m from Siglap TEL station, asking $1,192 PSF — a 33% discount to the project's $1,779 URA median PSF. The PSF is exceptional for a freehold D15 unit on the Thomson-East Coast Line, but the sheer size (2,013 sqft, $2.4M) narrows the resale pool and the value hinges on whether that low PSF reflects a tired unit rather than a true bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Compelling relative value: freehold tenure in deep-buyer-pool D15, 3-min walk to operational Siglap TEL station, and $1,192 PSF versus a $1,779 project median — a steep discount that, even allowing for unit condition, leaves real margin. URA resale-only CAGR of 5.3% (clean, no new-launch bias) supports the East Coast appreciation case, and the freehold + TEL combination is exactly the scarcity profile that holds value. Score 759 / MMR 1542 is the strongest in the batch and it sits on the efficient frontier. Held back from Strong Buy by the very low transaction count (5), the unusually large 2,013 sqft footprint that pushes the $2.4M quantum past the deepest liquidity band and limits the buyer set to large families, and the deep PSF discount which warrants viewing to confirm it isn't a condition-driven markdown.
red_flags: 2,013 sqft / $2.4M quantum is large and niche — narrower resale pool than a 1,000-1,300 sqft 3BR
33% PSF discount to project median may reflect a dated/unrenovated unit — verify on viewing
Only 5 URA transactions underpinning the appreciation figure — thin data
2005 build (~21yo) — older finishes despite freehold tenure
catalysts: Freehold + 250m to operational Siglap TEL station — durable scarcity in East Coast
$1,192 PSF vs $1,779 median — large built-in margin of safety
East Coast / D15 deep buyer pool and lifestyle premium; Bayshore/Long Island regional uplift nearby
Clean resale-only URA CAGR of 5.3% with no developer-pricing inflation

history.summary: A large freehold D15 3BR near operational Siglap TEL at a strikingly low $1,192psf — but the steep 'discount' is a verify-first signal (likely a dated/unrenovated boutique unit), not confirmable value remotely.
history.rating_rationale: $1,192psf sits BELOW even the cheapest D15 freehold comp (Park East floor ~$1,396psf; Esta/Amber $2,000-2,400psf), so the 33% gap to median is mostly age/condition + size, not a steal. v3.6+ trust rules correctly damp it. Freehold + 3-min walk to operational Siglap TEL gives real optionality and renovation headroom IF the unit is sound — but that needs an in-person check. Held at Neutral/low pending verification.
red_flags: $1,192psf far below all D15 freehold comps → condition/age risk
catalysts: freehold + low absolute PSF = renovation/optionality headroom
